notes: Per-PC file (gitignored). Copy to loop-segments-windows.json on each Windows PC. Empty rcloneConfigPath = auto-detect. Empty iCloudDownloads = %USERPROFILE%\iCloudDrive\Downloads (used by repo-root deploy.ps1). phoneLanHosts pools multiple iPhones for lan\Get-LoopSegmentsUnifiedLANListing.ps1; phoneLanHost remains the primary mount target for rclone. Companion starts rclone serve dlna (rcloneDlnaAddr / rcloneDlnaName) for Quest Skybox Network — not AirScreen of L:. phoneLanHostSource (super-config, set before companion; default config): config = force saved phoneLanHost; usb = current Wi-Fi via USB pcapd — preferUsbPhoneLanHost mirrors it; Set-LoopSegmentsPhoneLanHostSource.ps1. minLanThroughputMbps = companion/measure reboots other routers and re-checks when LAN probe is below this. skyboxExe = optional SKYBOX.exe path. virtualDesktopStreamerExe = optional VirtualDesktop.Streamer.exe path (companion starts Streamer if idle, starts the service if stopped, and hides Streamer to the tray).
